scenario.summary: On the Plumbing PLP opened by the head method, verifies the category heading and the listed sub-category tiles.
steps: Verify the sub-categories label is visible
Verify the sub-category names against the sheet list
assertions: Heading equals the upper-case category name
Sub-category tiles equal the sheet list
evidence: dependsOn navigateToProductListingPage. First method captures: the category record is declared by navigateToProductListingPage (class field); this method declares no need.
homePage!B28 'PLUMBING' is the category heading (upper-case rendering of category.name): data of the head's category record (class field), also declared on the head.

Not scanned: verifySubCategories compares the tiles with TestData.getHashMap(SCENARIO_TEST_DATA_NAME_PLUMBING); the migrated method checks category.subcategory1Name..subcategory4Name instead (CATEGORY_WITH_PRODUCTS returns at most 4; user decision 2026-11-10).

HEAD RECORD VALUES (first method captures): homePageLabels/categoryPlumbing1/Label -> category.name. These values belong to a record the head method declares (as data with that output there); this method has no needs, so they are recorded as expected-output copies (chain rule confirmed by the user 2026-11-10). The migrated method reads them from the class field (alias.output above), not from the sheet; after migration and rescan they leave this entry.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
